summary:
- Alt+Click any link to preview it in a floating Glance window, with options to dismiss or keep it as a tab.
- View two tabs side by side with Split View from the tab context menu.
- Dock any website into a collapsible side panel that persists across sessions.
- Type @keywords like @yt, @gh, and @maps in the address bar to search sites directly.
- Fullscreen videos now expand across the entire monitor without borders or sidebar intrusion.
- Toggle downloads with Ctrl+J, open completed files directly, and clear finished items.
- Save bandwidth and memory with Data Saver mode, larger disk caches, and background tab memory trimming.
- Customize the UI with accent color choices, emoji workspace icons, and right-side sidebar placement.
- Show visited site logos in history suggestions and automatically exit when closing the last tab.
